title: Least compatible DNF term index
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $\rho$ assign to each coordinate either no restriction, the value $1$, or the value $-1$. If at least one term of $\varphi$ is compatible with $\rho$, define the canonical index to be the least index in the formula's term list of a compatible term.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
$\rho$ assigns each coordinate one of the three restrictions
There is at least one term compatible with $\rho$
